text:
sarah (support): Hey team, acme reported a spike of 429 throttles on their Dedicated pool this morning. ticket INC-3421. customer sees high latency + generation errors. they say it started after a long-context batch job.
acme-corp-rep: yes, we sent large 12k token prompts in bursts. p50 jumped to ~450ms, p95 ~1.2s, and we started seeing 429/503 on the API. this is blocking nightly ingest.
ryan (ml-eng): can you paste their tenant id + pool? also any kv stats they sent?
acme-corp-rep: tenant-acme-prod, pool dedicated-us-west2-1. attaching the brief metrics we pulled client-side:
```
kv_evictions_per_min: 2200
kv_cache_util_pct: 94
kv_frag_ratio: 0.68
active_connections: 32
p50_gen_latency_ms: 450
http_429_rate_per_min: 12
```

tom (infra): those eviction numbers are huge. likely eviction churn due to long-context KV fills plus fragmentation. did autoscaler kick or increase replicas?
acme-corp-rep: autoscale didn't add new nodes. we saw scaling cooldowns and no scale-out for ~9 minutes.
infra-bot: autoscaler event log: pool=dedicated-us-west2-1, desired_replicas=2, current_replicas=2, scale_out_blocked=true, reason=cooldown(600s) since last scale action.
ryan (ml-eng): can you dump a server-side kv debug snippet from their node? any repeated evict logs or OOMs?
sarah (support): customer provided snippets from agent logs:
```
[2026-03-09T07:12:01Z] kv.cache.evict key=conv-9876 size=1.2MB cause=pressure
[2026-03-09T07:12:01Z] kv.cache.alloc failed id=conv-9878 reason=fragmentation
[2026-03-09T07:12:02Z] request 0xabc gen start model=redwood-x long_context=true
[2026-03-09T07:12:03Z] request 0xabc error code=429 msg="throttled: kv pressure"
```

tom (infra): looks like fragmentation + hot keys from long context. two hypotheses: (1) per-tenant KV reservation too small and eviction backoff too aggressive, (2) autoscaler cooldown prevented timely scale-out. both plausible.
emma (customer-success): customer wants a hotfix/workaround asap. what's a quick mitigation we can offer them while infra investigates?
ryan (ml-eng): short-term: reduce per-request context size (truncate older history) or change model variant to smaller context window. we can also flip their tenant to `kv_policy=aggressive-reserve` to bump reserved memory if ops approves.
tom (infra): ops can patch pool configuration: increase kv_memory_reserved_mb for tenant-acme-prod from 1024 -> 3072 and reduce autoscale cooldown to 120s. but that requires a deploy and approval. alternative is manual replica add.
sarah (support): repro steps I'm running locally against a dedicated mimic (small):
1) spawn 6 concurrent long-context requests (~10k tokens) to same tenant key prefix
2) watch `kv.cache.*` logs and eviction spikes
3) observe 429 when evictions spike and request queue length > 64
ryan (ml-eng): paste the autoscale config for that pool please.
sarah (support): config snippet:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 4
  cpu_threshold: 0.75
  kv_memory_reserved_mb: 1024
  cooldown_secs: 600
```

tom (infra): that cooldown is the smoking gun. with bursty long-context jobs the pool never recovers fast enough. Ops: can you authorize a manual scale to 4 replicas and temp cooldown change? @ops
acme-corp-rep: would appreciate that. ETA for manual scale?
infra-bot: manual replica change requested by tom — action queued: authorize via ops console.
emma (customer-success): I'll get the ops approval and schedule the manual scale. also notifying the account team to alert acme about the temporary change.
ryan (ml-eng): longer-term issues to open: (a) implement kv eviction prioritization to avoid hot-key thrashing, (b) add per-tenant soft-reservation bump when fragmentation high, (c) better autoscale heuristics that consider kv pressure metric, not just CPU.
tom (infra): +1. I'll open infra ticket INF-791 for the autoscaler heuristic change and tag runtime for eviction logic.
sarah (support): action items:
- ops: manual scale to 4 replicas and set cooldown to 120s (in progress) — @ops
- runtime: triage eviction backoff and fragmentation fallback — @ryan
- support: provide customer workaround steps (truncate context / switch variant) — sarah
acme-corp-rep: thanks, trying workaround now. will confirm if errors subside after scale.
emma (customer-success): ping me once scale done, I'll relay to acct team.
sarah (support): noted. marking this thread high-priority. :eyes:
tom (infra): quick note — if we push manual scale, watch for KV redistribution; we should roll replicas one at a time to avoid further thrashing.
acme-corp-rep: scale applied, errors dropped to ~1/min immediately. will test more.
sarah (support): great, keeping thread open for follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:"
